datenschutz.title: Privacy Policy
datenschutz.intro: bewerby processes your application data exclusively on this device. This policy describes what data technically arises, where it lives, and what rights you have.
datenschutz.principleBody: Everything you enter into bewerby - job title, company name, contact details, salary expectations, notes, and uploaded cover-letter PDFs - is stored exclusively in your browser's local storage (IndexedDB and the Origin Private File System). There is no server this content is sent to, received by, or stored on. The one exception is the contact form (see below): if you actively use it, exactly the contact details you enter there are transmitted in that request - otherwise bewerby makes no network connections at all beyond the application's initial load.
datenschutz.storageTitle: Where each kind of data lives
datenschutz.storageIndexedDbDesc: Holds every application record: job title, company, contact details, notes, priority, status, tags, dates, and the history of status changes.
datenschutz.storageOpfsDesc: Holds the binary data of uploaded PDFs: job ads, the stored CV, and optionally a separate CV per application. Each application only references a file name in this store.
datenschutz.storageLocalDesc: Holds only strictly technical, non-personal settings: your chosen color theme, chosen language, custom color labels, and internal markers for which reminders have already been shown. Since these entries are purely functional and serve no tracking purpose, no cookie consent is required for them.
datenschutz.storageKeyNotifiedDesc: Internal marker for reminders already shown
datenschutz.noTrackingTitle: No cookies, no tracking, no third parties
datenschutz.noTrackingBody: bewerby does not embed any analytics or tracking services, does not set cookies for advertising or statistics purposes, and does not load content from third-party servers. Fonts are bundled with the application locally instead of being loaded from an external font service.
datenschutz.hostingTitle: Server logs at the hosting provider
datenschutz.hostingBody: When you load this page, the hosting provider's web server processes technically unavoidable access data (e.g. IP address, time of access, requested file), as is standard for any website visit. These log entries concern only the delivery of the application itself, not the application data you enter within it. The retention period for these access logs is governed by the hosting provider's own terms.
datenschutz.rightsBody: Since all application data lives exclusively on your device, you exercise your rights to access, rectification, and erasure directly within the application: applications can be viewed, edited, and individually deleted at any time. Settings also lets you permanently delete all data in one click (right to erasure). The backup page lets you export all data as a file (right to data portability) and import it again.
datenschutz.contactFormBody: If you use the contact form, your name, email address, and message are forwarded by email to the controller. This is processed by a script on infrastructure the controller also operates themselves - not by a third party. It is not stored in a database, only delivered by email. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in responding to your inquiry).
datenschutz.changesBody: This policy will be updated whenever the actual data processing changes.
datenschutz.storageKeyProfileDesc: Sender details for the cover letter (name, address, email, phone) and the reference to the stored CV

nutzungsbedingungen.title: Terms of Use
nutzungsbedingungen.intro: These terms of use apply to using bewerby. By using the application, you agree to them.
nutzungsbedingungen.scopeBody: bewerby is a free, personal project for managing job application documents. There is no contractual relationship and no entitlement to any particular availability or functionality.
nutzungsbedingungen.serviceBody: bewerby runs entirely in the browser and processes all application data exclusively on the user's own device (see the Privacy Policy). It is not a cloud service with user accounts.
nutzungsbedingungen.dataResponsibilityBody: Since all application data is stored exclusively in the local browser, it is irrecoverably lost if browser data is cleared or a device is changed or fails, unless backed up beforehand. Creating your own backups via the Backup page is the user's own responsibility.
nutzungsbedingungen.availabilityBody: There is no entitlement to continuous availability, error-free operation, or continued development of bewerby. Access may be restricted or discontinued at any time without notice.
nutzungsbedingungen.liabilityBody: Use of bewerby is at your own risk. No liability is assumed for data loss, missed application opportunities, or other damages arising from use of the application, to the extent permitted by law. This does not apply to damages arising from injury to life, body, or health, or damages based on intent or gross negligence.
nutzungsbedingungen.changesBody: These terms of use may be updated if bewerby's scope of features changes. The current version is always available on this page.

landing.headline: Your applications stay on your device.
landing.lead: bewerby is a kanban board for job applications. No account, no transfer, no tracking.
landing.step1Body: Title, company, contact. Or upload the job ad as a PDF and let bewerby read the fields.
landing.step2Body: Write the cover letter in the editor, take the CV from your settings. Export both as PDF.
landing.step3Body: From draft through sent to offer. You set your own reminders.
landing.dataBody: Entries live in your browser's IndexedDB, attached PDFs in OPFS. Clear your browser data and the applications are gone. That is what the file export under Backup & Sync is for.
